translations.web: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
translations.bsb: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
translations.kjv: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
translations.asv: as it is taken off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace-offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of burnt-offering.
